title: THE HICKSTON INCIDENT
heading: BESSIE'S
COMIN' HOME

stations.label: UNBOLT THE FEED HATCH
stations.message: FEED HATCH OPEN. TAKE THE SHORT CUT.

hub_clues: COUNTY ROAD CREW: TAKE THE WEST TURN FOR TOWN.
PIN NINETEEN. THE COUNTY LINE MOVED, NOT THE PIN.
CULVERT OPEN. RETURN THE BORROWED TOOLS TO THE SHED.
notes: MUNDELL / YOUR HOG TAG WENT TO THE FAIR. CHECK THE BLUE TRUNK.

mill-leaky-standpipe: STANDPIPE SHUDDERS. STEP OFF THE GRATE.
quarry-cut-leak: COPPER JOINT WHISTLES. GIVE IT ROOM.

do.message: THE DISPATCH SAFE HAD A BELL ON IT. COMPANY IS COMING.
